proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x y hc hca hb hbs
  have ha : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hP : 0 ≤ (x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hd1 := Real.sq_sqrt hP
    have hd2 := Real.sq_sqrt hQ
    obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩ : ∃ d, d = Real.sqrt ((x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩ : ∃ d, d = Real.sqrt ((x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hd₁] at h hd1
    rw [← hd₂] at h hd2
    have hdiff : a * (d₂ - d₁) = 2 * c * x := by
      have : (d₂ - d₁) * (d₂ + d₁) = 4 * c * x := by linear_combination hd2 - hd1
      rw [add_comm d₂, h] at this
      linear_combination this / 2
    have hd₂a : a * d₂ = a ^ 2 + c * x := by
      have : a * (d₁ + d₂) = 2 * a ^ 2 := by rw [h]; ring
      linear_combination (hdiff + this) / 2
    have key : a ^ 2 * ((x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = (a ^ 2 + c * x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hd2, ← hd₂a]; ring
    field_simp
    rw [hbs]
    linear_combination key
  · intro h
    have hab : b ^ 2 * x ^ 2 + a ^ 2 * y ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * b ^ 2 := by
      field_simp at h
      linear_combination h
    have hxa : x ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ b ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2) := by
        have e : b ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2) = a ^ 2 * y ^ 2 := by linear_combination -hab
        rw [e]; positivity
      have := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h0 (by positivity : 0 < b ^ 2)
      linarith
    have habsx := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hxa ha.le
    have hca' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hca ha
    have hcx : c * x < a * a ∧ -(a * a) < c * x := by
      have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habsx.1 hc.le
      have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habsx.2 hc.le
      constructor <;> linarith
    have e₁ : (x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (a - c * x / a) ^ 2 := by
      have : a ^ 2 * ((x - c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = (a ^ 2 - c * x) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hbs] at hab; linear_combination hab
      field_simp
      linear_combination this
    have e₂ : (x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (a + c * x / a) ^ 2 := by
      have : a ^ 2 * ((x + c) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) = (a ^ 2 + c * x) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hbs] at hab; linear_combination hab
      field_simp
      linear_combination this
    have n₁ : 0 ≤ a - c * x / a := by
      rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_iff₀ ha]; exact hcx.1.le
    have n₂ : 0 ≤ a + c * x / a := by
      have : -a ≤ c * x / a := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]; linarith [hcx.2]
      linarith
    rw [e₁, e₂, Real.sqrt_sq n₁, Real.sqrt_sq n₂]
    ring
